name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Standardize a one-page "Decision Log" template for every team to record every nontrivial choice, its reason, and the trade-off accepted. Product Ops owns it. The trade-off is upfront time to fill the log versus long-term clarity and faster onboarding.

name: Scriv
text: The real risk is that a one-page "Decision Log" template becomes another box-ticking exercise if Product Ops enforces it without tying it to actual decisions. Instead, mandate that every RFC or sprint plan must include a *decision section* in the existing artifact (e.g., Confluence page or Notion doc) with the same fields—no new template. Product Ops verifies compliance by checking the section exists, not by creating a new log. Settle it by running a 2-week pilot where teams use the section in their existing docs; if adoption stalls, revisit enforcement.
